description: Whether an account is in a ranked game right now and, if so, the lobby TrackDIFF shows on its Live Game tab: `gameId`, `startedAtMs`, bans, and all ten participants with champion, team, summoner spells, keystone, current rank/LP, primary role, their win rate on the champion they are playing (0–1), and public persona. `in_game: false` means no game is in progress (or the account is not indexed). Data comes from TrackDIFF's own live-game tracker and may lag a game start by a minute or two.
name: get_player_live_game
title: Player's current game
